purpose: Central registry of validation runs supporting property fixture governance, preserving run identity, scope, result and separation from legal verification and publication.
registry_rules: Every governance validation run receives one immutable registry entry.
A run result cannot be silently changed.
Later validation requires a new run ID.
Technical validation status is separate from legal-source verification.
Technical validation status is separate from publication readiness.
guardrails: A passed technical run does not establish Irish property-law correctness.
A passed run does not establish ownership, title, boundary or any other real property fact.
No run may claim live official retrieval unless an actual retrieval event and evidence record exist.
Registry entries preserve historical validation results.
